NIRSCoordinateSystemDescription: Idealised spherical head model of the BBCI toolbox montage file (mnt.mat, pos_3d on the unit sphere) scaled to a head radius of 0.095 m. Origin at the centre of the sphere, +X towards the right ear (T8), +Y towards Fpz (anterior), +Z towards the vertex (Cz).
NIRSCoordinateProcessingDescription: Nominal 10-10 cap positions, not digitised. The paper reports a nominal inter-optode distance of 30 mm.
